reason: Evidence from the repository README, package metadata, and description indicates the plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness extension for integrating a local Ollama service: it registers an LLM adapter, exposes Ollama model management and health tools, and offers rule-based local routing with cloud fallback and a `/ollama` status command. The observed functionality is centered on local-model provider integration and operational tooling, not general editing, UI, or non-AI workflow automation.

summaries.zh: 本插件用于将本地 Ollama 提供商接入 DeepSeek Harness，按规则路由请求到本地模型，并提供模型列表、拉取、查看与移除等管理工具及 `/ollama` 状态命令。
summaries.en: This plugin integrates a local Ollama provider into DeepSeek Harness, routing requests by rule to local models and providing model management plus a `/ollama` status command.

capabilities: Routes requests to local Ollama models through a DSH adapter based on configurable rules.
Calls Ollama HTTP API endpoints for model listing, inspection, pull/delete operations, and health checks.
Runs a local CLI-based probe (`ollama list`) during health checks.
Uses a local/cloud fallback path when a local route fails before first-token output.

reasons.code: Model-management and tooling features are explicitly documented (ollama_list, ollama_show, ollama_pull, ollama_remove, ollama_health).
Request routing by purpose/keywords/always plus fallback-to-cloud behavior is described in the plugin overview and architecture text.
The plugin manifest and README show subprocess usage for health probing and network access as explicit operational behavior.
Network-to-endpoint model operations imply handling model metadata and generated content between host and Ollama endpoint.
